candidate.title: inDrop
candidate.scope: The middle row labeled inDrop (High-throughput single-cell labeling with indexing droplets) in the assigned Illumina single-cell poster schematic, interpreted for the original Klein et al. 2015 hydrogel-primer implementation. The complete attached crop also contains an upper Hi-SCL row, a lower partial Nuc-Seq row and part of a chemical legend; these are adjacent context, not alternatives or branches of the assigned inDrop row. CEL-Seq is an embedded downstream library component reported in the primary paper, not another target. The poster's separate cell-loading and microsphere branches and its broad downstream block are retained, with explicit primary-paper interpretation of co-encapsulation, droplet disruption and the sequenced carrier. This is a schematic architecture, not a complete laboratory protocol or a claim about later inDrop versions.
